transport.title: Protocol of a new output
transport.description: AmneziaWG works on any router with the WireGuard module. MASQUE looks like ordinary HTTP/3 to the provider.

count.title: Tunnels in a new output
count.description: More than one: spare tunnels, the output switches to them at once when one stops answering.

pick.title: Which tunnel a new output takes
pick.description: The fastest, or the first one that answers.

exclude_countries.title: Countries a new output avoids
exclude_countries.description: Two-letter codes separated by commas, for example RU,BY. Empty: any country.
